form.label: Service Health Overview
form.description: Error rate, latency, and volume across services — import via Settings > User Interface > Dashboards > New Dashboard > Source

search.query: index=app_logs sourcetype=json_logs service=$service_tok$ | eval is_error=if(status_code>=400, 1, 0) | stats count as total, sum(is_error) as errors by service | eval error_rate_pct=round((errors/total)*100, 2) | sort -error_rate_pct
index=app_logs sourcetype=json_logs service=$service_tok$ | stats perc50(latency_ms) as p50_ms, perc95(latency_ms) as p95_ms by service | sort -p95_ms
index=app_logs sourcetype=json_logs service=$service_tok$ | timechart span=1m count by service
index=app_logs sourcetype=json_logs service=$service_tok$ status_code>=400 | stats count by endpoint, status_code | sort -count | head 10
